title: How should I prepare my child for their first Speech Therapy session?
metaTitle: Preparing for First Speech Therapy Session | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how to prepare your child for their first speech therapy session with Pinnacle Blooms Network and make it a positive experience.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we believe the journey of therapy can be a rewarding one for your child. When preparing for the first speech therapy session, keep the communication simple and positive. Compare it with fun activities your child understands, like 'we are going to play some speaking games'! Remember, we are here to ensure that the experience is gentle and pleasing for both you and your child.
